argv: echo "knowledge notes=$(find corpus/knowledge -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" | wc -l)"; for f in corpus/knowledge/*.md; do b=$(basename "$f"); r=$(grep -c -E "^\| *\`knowledge/$b\`" corpus/README.md); printf "%s %s\n" "$r" "$b"; done | sort -n; echo "first-column rows=$(grep -c -E "^\| *\`knowledge/[^\`]+\.md\`" corpus/README.md)"; grep -n -E "^## Round 1[678]|case 7|case 8|sources-check|ledger leg" corpus/README.md | cut -c1-220
